evidence: Market sentiment has deteriorated rapidly over the preceding five days, falling from a neutral reading of 49 on January 18 to 20 (Extreme Fear) on January 22. While deep extreme fear historically offers contrarian rebound opportunities over medium horizons, rapid day-over-day sentiment deterioration reflects active selling pressure and negative momentum that often persists into 24-hour windows. Balancing the immediate downward momentum against potential mean-reversion buying near capitulation levels yields a slightly below-even probability of 0.47 for an upward daily close.
